name: inventory_panel
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset for a Unity fantasy RPG UI. Cohesive refined hand-painted style: midnight blue/slate blue, muted champagne gold metal, restrained pale teal highlights, delicate engraved celestial ornament. Straight-on orthographic flat 2D game UI sprite, clean readable silhouette, crisp edges. No text, letters, numbers, items, characters, watermark, mockup, or scene. Real alpha transparency outside the asset, never a checkerboard baked into pixels. Generate ONE tall rectangular inventory/chest window background, portrait 2:3 aspect ratio. Thin gold engraved frame, modest decorative corners, small celestial crest centered at top. Opaque dark navy interior, very subtle painted texture. Large uninterrupted empty quiet interior for placing inventory grid; empty top title strip. No internal slots or buttons. Frame occupies under 8 percent of width, 3 percent transparent padding outside. Elegant and practical, not excessively ornate.
